_comment: Text source for the VR menu. build_resonance_ui.py bakes it into WBP_ResonanceMenu; rerun the script after editing. Clients are fictional.

landing.headline: Rehearse the first call before the real one.
landing.body: Resonance gives counseling trainees a virtual client who listens, hesitates and answers with a believable face.
steps: Read the case. Check your mic.
Talk to the client in the headset.
Replay the turns. Note what you'd change.

clients.name: Anna M.
clients.situation: Laid off after eleven years; unsure if asking for help is weakness.

clients.name: Jonas K.
clients.situation: Caring for his mother. Exhausted, won't say so.

clients.name: Peter W.
clients.situation: Lost his partner last spring. The house is too quiet.

scenarios.title: First call
scenarios.situation: She hesitates before speaking and may say "I probably shouldn't have called." She goes quiet when she feels judged.
scenarios.goal: To hear whether her feelings are normal. She isn't looking for advice yet.
scenarios.focus: Let pauses breathe. Reflect feelings before asking questions.
